boot_command.note: This command runs only when the node starts. No wake can start the node now, and stopped.note says why. kill_command cancels the command.

custom_image.note: your own image, supervised by the platform: its entrypoint never runs (the platform keeps the node alive for run_command), and only the home path survives stops - everything else resets every wake

last_failure.error: provisioning failed after attempt 1: container runtime error: every 8-core CPU carve slot on this worker is occupied

calendar.note: Fridays 33% off, weekends 20% off (US Pacific) - applied to the minutes that run on those days, not locked at create

stopped.note: There is no copy of its disk to restore from: the host that held the disk is gone, and the stored copy cannot be used. Nothing is running or billing, and a retry cannot change this. Our operators see this node in their fleet checks. If you do not need the disk, delete_node it and create_node a fresh one (new empty disk).
